prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: fixed-background 2D RPG town map for a complete one-screen quest
Primary request: Create an original tiny fantastical town called Moonroot Hollow, designed from the start for fast, unambiguous playability.
Scene/backdrop: a cozy twilight settlement grown around an enormous silver-barked hollow tree; mushroom-roof cottages and crooked timber shops ring one broad village clearing; luminous blue plants, hanging amber lanterns, violet forest, and distant firefly haze.
Subject and gameplay layout: the lower half is one large, continuous, clearly readable oval clearing of moss-edged cobblestone. Keep a wide unobstructed player spawn at bottom center and generous walking lanes around a small circular glowing moonwell at center. At the left edge of the clearing, include one clearly visible friendly mushroom apothecary NPC in a plum robe beside a tiny herb stall. At the right edge, include one clearly visible antlered gatekeeper NPC beside a luminous root arch. Keep both NPCs on the edge of, not inside, the walking lanes. The moonwell, apothecary, and gatekeeper must be visually distinct quest landmarks.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted pixel-art RPG background, charming 16-bit-inspired detail with consistent pixel scale, readable silhouettes, restrained outlines, and no photorealism.
Composition/framing: exact 16:9 landscape fixed camera, elevated three-quarter RPG view. Put buildings and giant tree in the upper half; reserve the lower half for simple gameplay. One elevation only. No hidden paths, stairs, bridges, cliffs, roofs crossing the clearing, or deep perspective ambiguities.
Lighting/mood: luminous blue-violet twilight with warm lantern accents; magical, safe, inviting, and high enough contrast for a small player sprite.
Constraints: raster artwork only; no main player character; exactly the two described NPCs; no extra people or creatures; no HUD, dialogue box, title, labels, letters, numbers, text, icons, arrows, borders, watermark, or logo; no fountain other than the small central moonwell; no foreground foliage covering the lower-center spawn or walking lanes.
